My guard-mutation probe's M6 anchor spanned a line break in the YAML and did not match -- the SAME line-wrapping failure mode this project keeps encountering. In the prior evaluation I reported the F4 mechanism incorrectly -- lowercase-prose-only -- when the OCI document also carries a title-cased occurrence as an Autonomous Database workload type. The finding's substance was right and its stated reason was wrong.
known_issues_or_risks: The retraction guard is a phrase-list guard and cannot catch an arbitrary novel rephrasing of the refuted claim (measured: M4 passes). This is inherent rather than a defect. The semantic backstop is test_perpetuity_neither_entails_nor_precludes_zero_cost, which asserts the underlying fact in both directions independently of wording.

test_perpetuity_neither_entails_nor_precludes_zero_cost deliberately pins directional facts rather than exact counts, so the prose's numbers (14/5/5/4) are NOT test-pinned and can drift as provider slices are added. The builder states this tradeoff explicitly, and the alternative would force unrelated slices to edit Oracle's documentation. Recommend the next provider slice re-derives these numbers as part of its own contract.

The coverage rationales remain wording-pinned rather than truth-pinned, because the captures are honestly declared minimal excerpts. Unchanged from the prior evaluation and cannot produce a false-free claim.
